core.title: 4 Inch Smooth Iron H Hinge, Acorn AH5BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AH5BQ, 4" Smooth Iron H Hinges

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home and this Iron H Hinge is forged with this attention to quality in mind. For interior and exterior doors, the smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The 4 Inch Smooth Iron H Hinge has an overall width of 2 inches. It has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Available Sizes of the 4" Smooth Black Iron Hinges:

  • Suitable as heavy cabinet hinges or for use on light interior doors.
  • Height: 4"
  • Overall Width: 2"

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Priced and sold as a pair (2-hinges).
